system.notes: The last of the surgeon's bill came out of his discharge money, and he keeps the receipt.
system.biography: Turned down by the Pilots' Guild at eighteen and taken by the levy the same week. Two terms on the Reach Guard's picket boats ended when a turret capacitor blew beside him: the Guard paid three quarters of the surgeon and discharged him. He went down to the quay, where nobody asks for a certificate, and earned a badge slinging cargo.

demo.cliff: a commission moves the record onto the ladder its assignment names
teaches: Three assignments share one enlisted ladder and one officer ladder, each named by id: ladder is the one entered on, officerLadder the one a commission moves to. The officer ladder carries officer: true, or the template reports it.

commission: true and commissionCheck add the commission step: a pass puts the record at rank 1 of the officer ladder and pays that rung's bonus at once. After the first term the roll needs SOC 9+ and takes DM-1 for each term served.
tables.officer is requiresCommission: it is offered only to a Traveller on the officer ladder, beside the three tables everyone rolls on.

Forced out by advancement is not a field: an Advancement total at or under the terms served in this career ends it, and the record closes as forcedOutByAdvancement. Row 4's DM-2 makes that likelier, and a natural 12 is the opposite: the Traveller must stay.
basicFrom: assignment takes basic training from the assignment's own table rather than Service Skills, so a picket hand and a signaller start with different skills.
assignmentChange: requalifyKeepRank makes a new assignment a fresh Qualification roll, the age DM included: a pass keeps the rank, a failure keeps the old assignment.
Row 9's throw is keyed to the assignment: each of the three is offered its own skill and target, and nobody is asked which.
pensionable pays a pension to a Traveller who leaves after five terms or more, and medicalBillsRow: military pays the largest share of an injury's care.

Row 3 ejects only a Traveller who refuses its question and row 2 lets the mishap it rolls decide. Mishap 2 ejects but keeps the term's Benefit roll, which a failed Survival roll would otherwise cost; mishap 3 injures an associate rather than the Traveller, and mishap 4 ejects only on a failed check.
demo.trap: The officer ladder starts at rank 1 and has no rank 0, because a commission enters it at rank 1 and pays that rung's bonus. exitRule.track stays blank, and must for a forced exit to happen: a career with a leaving track reads the Advancement total against that track instead. standingModifiers and tracks stay empty because the Guard prints no footnote and no track. The eleven record fields below the tables stay empty, as on every template.

system.description: Bellweather's system-defence service: the picket boats on the Reach, the orbital gun platforms, and the signals watch that ties them to the quay. It commissions officers onto a ladder of their own, pays a pension after a long service, and covers most of an injury's care. Invented for this pack, and no book's career.

bonus.text: A Patron on the Reach council

eventTable.text: A picket boat breaks up on the outer buoys with you aboard. Take a roll on the Mishap table; that row decides whether you stay.
A board of inquiry sits over a boat lost on your watch. Give evidence against your captain, and gain an Enemy and DM+2 held for your next Advancement roll; refuse, and the Guard lets you go.

tray.note: Your evidence is noted: DM+2 held for one Advancement roll.

eventTable.text: A live-fire drill on the outer buoys hits the wrong buoy. Gain one level of Gunner, and carry DM-2 into your next Advancement roll.

tray.note: The drill is remembered: DM-2 on one Advancement roll, which brings a total at or under your terms served closer.

eventTable.text: The Guard sends you up to the orbital yard for a season of courses. Make an EDU check (8+): pass, and gain one level in a skill you already hold.

grant.text: One level in a skill you hold

eventTable.text: Your captain mentions you in a dispatch to the Reach council. Gain one level of Tactics or Leadership, and DM+2 held for your next Commission or Advancement roll, whichever comes first.

tray.note: The dispatch: DM+2 held for one Commission or Advancement roll, spent by the first of them.

eventTable.text: Life Event: the shared Life Events table answers this one.
A harbour patrol captain who served beside you on the Reach asks for you by name. Gain a Contact; if you leave, the patrol takes you at your next qualification with no roll.

A freighter drifts into the exclusion zone with its transponder dark. Turn it back with Pilot (8+) on the picket boats, Gunner (9+) on the platforms or Electronics (7+) on the watch: succeed, and gain a Contact and DM+1 held for your next Advancement roll; fail, and its master becomes a Rival.

tray.note: The freighter turned back: DM+1 held for one Advancement roll.

eventTable.text: You are seconded to the mainland signals school for a season. Gain one level of Electronics, and one extra roll on a skill table this term.
The Lord Warden reads your file twice. Your next Commission or Advancement roll passes without dice, when you choose to spend it.

tray.note: The Lord Warden's notice: one Commission or Advancement roll passes without dice, on the holder's word.

eventTable.text: You hold the gap in the picket line alone through a solar storm. Take a promotion, or a commission if you do not yet hold one.

mishapTable.text: A turret capacitor lets go beside you. Two throws on the Injury table, the worse one counts, and the Guard discharges you.
The signals logs you kept go missing before an audit. Gain an Enemy in Reach command and leave the Guard, though the board lets you keep this term's Benefit roll.
A misfire on the gunnery range hurts the loader beside you. The loader rolls on the Injury table and holds you to blame as a Rival; you are sent home.
The Reach council cuts the picket budget. Make a Leadership or Admin check (8+) to keep a berth on what remains; fail, and you leave.
Eleven weeks adrift in a crippled boat. Lose 1 END and leave the Guard.
A hull breach on a boarding drill. One throw on the Injury table; the Guard keeps you on.

demo.cliff: a refused Traveller has nowhere to go without a career that is always open
teaches: alwaysAvailable opens the career to a Traveller refused elsewhere this term, who enters as fallbackCareer: the refusal's always-open choice finds it by that field, in the world and in every Item pack but a demo one, so this template answers only once it is imported into the world.

qualification.entry: automatic and difficulty 0 mean nobody rolls to join, so the line names no characteristic and no DM; alwaysAvailable also lifts the one-term bar on returning to a career just left.
neverEjects overrides every row: each mishap keeps the ejects a Mishap table prints, and the term log reads that this career cannot eject.
A failed Survival roll still rolls a mishap and still costs the term's Benefit roll, but the term goes on to its Event and Advancement; mishap 6's benefit: keep gives that roll back.
neverEjects is no bar on leaving: the Traveller may leave at the end of any term, and an Advancement roll at or under the terms served still forces them out.

Event 3 forces a career: careerMode force names Demo — Harbour Lock-up, careerCondition checkFailed sends the Traveller there only on a failed Deception check, and the compulsion closes this career at the end of the term, as blocked, though it never ejects.
basicFrom: assignment trains each hand from their own gang's table, and assignmentChange: free moves them between gangs at the end of any term, with no roll and no loss of rank.
Event 5 is a wager with an open stake: benefitCount 0 lets the player stake any number of the Benefit rolls this career owes.
medicalBillsRow: civilian, because the harbour's dock fund pays an injured hand's care as an employer does.
demo.trap: The mishap rows read ejects on purpose: neverEjects is what keeps the Traveller, so a row copied into another career ejects there. Event 3 names Demo — Harbour Lock-up by its name: until that career is entered, the compulsion waits on the tray and every other career refuses the Traveller. qualification.characteristics is empty because nothing is rolled. pensionable is false; standingModifiers and tracks stay empty because the career prints neither, and the record fields below the tables stay empty, as on every template.

system.description: Bellweather's dock labour, hired at the gate every dawn: whoever turns up is taken on, and nobody is thrown off. The career a refused Traveller can always enter, and one of its events can end in the harbour lock-up. Invented for this pack, and no book's career.

eventTable.text: A crane jib folds over a hold full of hands. Roll on this career's Mishap table.

A foreman offers you a share of a stack that is on no manifest. Take it, and gain one level of Streetwise, then make a Deception check (8+): fail, and the customs men are waiting, and your next term is served in Demo — Harbour Lock-up. Turn it down, and the foreman becomes a Rival.
Night shifts in the cold stores. Gain one level of Vacc Suit or Mechanic.

The cranes race at the end of every shift, and the whole quay bets on them. Stake as many of this career's Benefit rolls as you like on a Gambler check (8+): win, and half as many again come back, rounded up; lose, and the stake is gone.
A season on the lighters across the harbour. Gain one level of Seafarer, Athletics or Drive.
Life Event: roll on the shared Life Events table.
A ship's purser comes to trust your tallies. Gain a Contact aboard, and DM+1 held for one Benefit roll from this career.

tray.note: The purser's word: DM+1 held for one Benefit roll from this career.

eventTable.text: The gangs walk off the quay for a month. Walk out with them, and gain an Ally among the hands; cross the line instead, and gain an Enemy among them and DM+1 held for your next Advancement roll.

tray.note: The foremen remember who worked: DM+1 held for one Advancement roll.

eventTable.text: A visiting captain short of a hand takes you along for one run up the coast. Gain one level of Vacc Suit, and an extra roll on any of this career's skill tables.
The quay steward gives you a gang to run through the storm season. Gain one level of Leadership, and DM+2 held for your next Advancement roll.

tray.note: The storm season's gang: DM+2 held for one Advancement roll.

eventTable.text: You bring in the cargo of a wreck no other gang would touch. Gain an automatic promotion.

mishapTable.text: A load slips its sling above you. Roll on the Injury table twice, and the better of the two results stands.
A ship's master swears your gang robbed his hold, and he names you. Gain an Enemy.
Storms close the quay for a season, and nobody is paid. You forfeit one Benefit roll.
A cargo your gang slung goes into the harbour, and the foreman takes a rank off you.
A fight on the night shift. Make a Melee check (7+): win, and gain one level of Melee; lose, and gain a Rival.
A winter of frozen rope ruins your grip, but the gang works your shifts for you. STR -1, and you keep this term's Benefit roll.

demo.cliff: a refused career leaves no record, so a draft, a mishap and a debt are read off the careers that followed
teaches: A refused qualification deletes the career it was rolled for: the Pilots' Guild is on no sheet here, and the Reach Guard's entryMode of drafted is what remembers it.
A mishap closes the term early and banks no Benefit roll for it, and the surgeon's bill goes to finance.debt until the finish pays it out of Cash.
demo.trap: The refusal needs a GM seat and EDU 8 or under: a player is barred with nothing recorded, and EDU 9 is admitted with no roll. Debt reads 0 because the finish paid it, so the Cr2,500 survives only in characteristicLog and the term log.
